content.text: why were my companions Moongrum on the host's side?

**Summons:** your names, gear and face changes only happen on your machine. When you summon, the game sends peers just the three Moongrum IDs from `er-npc-summons.toml` (body 523590024, AI 523590100, gear 23590). The host's game builds each companion from its own unmodified Moongrum rows, and the host's copy of the mod only dresses companions it summoned itself. That's why they were Moongrum in name, gear and moves.
